_doc: SSv2 template → MoProbe roles and instruction patterns. Placeholders A,B,C follow the template's [something] order. actor/patient are placeholder indices (0-based) or 'hand'. direction_expected: screen-space expectation for the actor (right, left, up, down, toward_B, away_B, none, any). static_caption: the instruction describes an event in which the named object must NOT move. neutral = Physics-IQ style (scene + subject + initial action, no outcome words); explicit = adds direction/outcome words (used by T2 only).

8.neutral: A hand holds {A} above {B} and lets go of it.
8.explicit: A hand drops {A}; it falls down behind {B}.

9.neutral: A hand holds {A} up in front of {B} and lets go of it.
9.explicit: A hand drops {A}; it falls straight down in front of {B}.

10.neutral: A hand holds {A} above {B} and lets go of it.

12.neutral: A hand holds {A} above {B} and lets go of it.

counterfactual_pairs._doc: Same first frame, alternative instruction. For each listed template the 'alt' instruction is written for the same frame; the alt item has no reference video unless the pair is a natural SSv2 sibling.
